title: January 2027 remote interop day with Haven (proposed in #mimi 238481)
description: Proposed to Jason Bolduc in #mimi 238481 (2026-11-16): a remote interop day in January 2027, once Haven delivers messages and Commits from rooms on other hubs and keeps the ratchet tree (his list, 238476), then the IETF 128 hackathon table (Kuala Lumpur, 2027-03-06/07). Date not set yet. The checks below are what to run; each is a child bead. mimid needs no new features for them: follower delivery, committer authorization (hub/policy.rs authorize_commit), the strictness settings (mimid-1wgh.52) and OTLP export already exist.
notes: Worth knowing for the interop day: MIMI's call story is split across mimi-content §5.10 (the session disposition and join URI, with calling declared out of scope) and mimi-room-policy §5 L542 (a call room as fixed_membership plus parent_dependent), with neither citing the other, and room-policy's version forbids the obvious case per our own open issue #40. So if a call comes up with Haven, expect no agreement to be possible; see mimid-1wgh.37.106.
